result.title: Persistence Positional Encoding: A Minimal Transformer Recipe for Persistence Diagrams
result.summary: Persistence diagrams (PDs) represent multiscale topological information as multisets of birth-death pairs $(b,d)$. How best to use them with Transformers, however, remains unclear. Connecting PDs to Transformers requires choosing how topological information is tokenized and exposed to self-attention. Prior methods use specialized designs for tokenization, aggregation, Transformer blocks, or attention, but are hard to compare since reported results rarely share PD inputs, splits, or model-selection rules. We instead confine the diagram-specific design to point representation, mapping each birth-death pair through fixed random Fourier features while leaving the Transformer backbone unchanged, and call this recipe Persistence Positional Encoding (PPE). In matched controls on eight TU graph benchmarks (TU8), changing only point representation shifts macro accuracy by 5.49 to 6.47 percentage points (pp), against 0.47 to 1.45 pp from changing the downstream module, identifying point representation as the dominant design variable tested. We further reevaluate vectorizations, kernels, learned representations, and Transformer-based models under one protocol with shared PD inputs, outer folds, and validation-only selection. Among all evaluated PD methods and downstream configurations, PPE achieves the highest mean on most benchmarks, including TU8, ORBIT5K, and MCB-C. Finally, we prove that grid averaging leaves a reconstruction error at any resolution, whereas a Transformer with fixed random Fourier frequencies is almost surely universal. PPE thus offers a minimal, Transformer-native baseline for persistence diagrams, and a common protocol for future comparison.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何把 persistence diagram 的 birth-death 点对最简地接入 Transformer：只用固定随机 Fourier 特征表示每个点、保持骨干不变（PPE），在 TU8、ORBIT5K 等基准上按统一协议与各类向量化、核方法和 Transformer 模型比较，并证明网格平均在任何分辨率下都留有重构误差，而固定随机频率的 Transformer 几乎必然通用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「点表示主导、骨干次要」的对照结论与网格平均的不可重构性分析，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何编码进 latent 状态、固定分辨率网格是否导致细节坍缩提供类比线索；原文不涉及多模态推理，属远领域启发，需核查。
